en.title: Platform-aware button
en.description: One large button for the right platform, small links to the other builds and a checksum. Self-contained — one file, no dependencies.
en.docs: The block is self-contained: one file, no dependencies, its own palette in the local --vibeui-download-006-* variables. A server component. The platform arrives as a prop rather than being sniffed from navigator: the block stays server-rendered and never flashes a swapped label after hydration. A project that wants auto-detection just passes the value itself. The checksum is monospaced and wraps at any character, so it never stretches the section on a narrow screen.
